79c112ac12d89cc4c2881a3b23c05b5eb05fbc98.summary: A BlackBerry Research & Intelligence methodology write-up on running an Apple macOS 11 ARM64e kernel under the QEMU emulator. It is aimed at security researchers and pen-testers for debugging and vulnerability discovery. It describes building the emulator, patching boot blockers and reaching a shell. It does not report on a threat actor, malware family, vulnerability or incident.
